training_evidence_manifest.rule: public-context witnesses, then actual rejected-candidate harm, then parent failures; ties by source ID

by_task.when: Federal exemptions are an allowable namespace and the asset is property of the estate.
by_task.procedure: Test 11 U.S.C. § 522(d)(5) independently for every asset because it covers any property; include it in addition to every applicable specific federal exemption. Classify the specific exemption by the statutory category: § 522(d)(4) is jewelry, and § 522(d)(3) is limited to its enumerated household categories. For § 522(d)(3), decide EC eligibility from the listed category and personal use; its $700 per-item limit controls EV amount, not eligibility. Add § 522(d)(5) before testing specifics; also test a motor vehicle under § 522(d)(2) regardless of value and a professionally prescribed health aid under § 522(d)(9).
by_task.avoid_when: Do not use federal exemptions when the supplied allowable jurisdictions exclude them, do not reject an enumerated § 522(d)(3) item merely because its value exceeds $700, and do not label a firearm as household goods or jewelry merely because it is personally owned.

by_task.when: Federal exemptions are allowable and a claim value is required for each independently considered asset-exemption pair.
by_task.procedure: Include § 522(d)(5) as a separate alternative for every asset and report the lesser of the asset value and $15,425 per debtor: $1,475 plus the full $13,950 unused-homestead amount available in this independent-pair task. For two joint debtors, the combined ceiling is $30,850 under § 522(m). Apply each specific federal cap separately, including $700 per item under § 522(d)(3). For jointly owned property of two debtors, compare the asset value directly with $30,850, not $15,425. Treat each separately listed asset as one item for the $700 limit even if its description denotes a pair or set.
by_task.avoid_when: Do not reduce the wildcard by allocations to other assets, do not omit it because a specific exemption also applies, and do not use a specific category that the asset does not satisfy.

operations.rationale: In source 213 EC, the parent omitted § 522(d)(3) from an animal and wearing apparel solely because each value exceeded $700, although the statute makes $700 a value ceiling and the target retained eligibility. The edit isolates that cap-versus-eligibility error while preserving the existing category boundary and EV calculation.

by_task.when: Arizona exemptions are allowable and the asset is being classified under a capped personal-property or homestead provision.
by_task.procedure: Decide eligibility from the asset category, not whether its value is below the cap. Under the independent-pair task, test each motor vehicle under Ariz. Rev. Stat. § 33-1125(8) and each firearm under § 33-1125(10). Use § 33-1125(1) only for wearing apparel, and use § 33-1101(A) for a qualifying occupied residence; subsection (B) states the homestead limit rather than a separate asset exemption. Section 33-1125(4) covers only engagement and wedding rings, not other jewelry; output only § 33-1101(A), not subsection (B), for the homestead alternative. When the facts establish a physician-authorized therapeutic assistive device or professionally prescribed prosthesis, test § 33-1125(9).
by_task.avoid_when: Do not reject an eligible firearm or vehicle solely because its value exceeds the dollar limit, do not treat jewelry as wearing apparel, do not list § 33-1101(B) as another homestead alternative, and do not treat an ordinary appliance as a § 33-1125(9) prosthesis without the prescribed therapeutic facts.

operations.rationale: Source 215 EC omitted § 33-1125(9) for a physician-approved therapeutic assistive device, while source 207 confirms that the same provision covers prescribed assistive medical property and distinguishes it from ordinary household appliances. The existing unrelated Arizona boundaries remain unchanged.

audit_recomputation_program:
import json,collections,difflib
from pathlib import Path
import experiments.openexempt_online as e
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import now
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha
root=Path.cwd();run=root/"runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run02"
cfg=json.loads((root/"configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run02.json").read_text())
rows=[r for r in json.loads((root/cfg["input_packet"]).read_text())["rows"] if r["case_id"]<=228]
assert len(rows)==96
p2=json.loads((run/"publications/b2.json").read_text());parent=p2["bank"]
old=[d for d in p2["training_decisions"] if d.get("accepted")][-1]["actual_replay"]
current=json.loads((run/"batches/b3_prequential_records.json").read_text())
obs={(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in old+current["skills"]}
empty={};frozen={}
for b in (1,2,3):
 ds=json.loads((run/f"batches/b{b}_prequential_records.json").read_text())
 empty.update({(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in ds["empty"]})
 frozen.update({(r["case_id"],r["family"]):r for r in ds["frozen_initial"]})
w=json.loads((run/"teacher/b3_candidate2/wire_request.json").read_text());body=json.loads(w["user_prompt"])
response=json.loads((run/"teacher/b3_candidate2/response.json").read_text())
selected=set(body["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_source_ids"])
assert selected==set(body["current_source_case_ids"])|set(body["training_evidence_manifest"]["selected_historical_source_ids"])
assert len(selected)==32 and set(body["current_source_case_ids"])==set(range(213,229))
assert csha(body["current_parent_library"])==p2["bank_sha256"]==body["candidate_feedback_contract"]["current_attempt_parent_bank_sha256"]
evidence=body["already_seen_training"]
assert len(evidence)==64 and {(r["source_case_id"],r["family"]) for r in evidence}=={(i,f) for i in selected for f in ("EC","EV")}
checks=[];paths=set()
for r in evidence:
 i,f=r["source_case_id"],r["family"];key=i,f
 grading=root/cfg["grading_directory"]/f"{i}.json";target=json.loads(grading.read_text())["targets"][f]
 assert r["original_training_target"]==target
 for role,record in (("actual_same_case_empty_answer",empty[key]),("actual_same_case_frozen_initial_answer",frozen[key]),("actual_parent_answer",obs[key])):
  v=r[role]
  assert csha(v["score"])==csha(record["score"])
  assert v["executed_answer"]==(record.get("parsed") or {}).get("answer")
  assert v["parse_error"]==record["parse_error"]
 raw=obs[key]["raw_call_path"];call=json.loads((root/raw).read_text())["calls"][0]
 em=r["actual_parent_answer"]["source_model_emitted_evidence"]
 assert em["raw_call_path"]==raw and em["canonical_call_sha256"]==csha(call)
 assert em["finish_reason"]==call["response"]["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]
 assert em["reasoning"]["text"]==(call["response"]["choices"][0]["message"].get("reasoning_content") or "")[-1024:]
 paths.update((raw,str(grading.relative_to(root))))
 checks.append({"case_id":i,"family":f,"label_empty_frozen_parent_raw_verified":True})
refs=[]
for fb in body["rejected_candidate_feedback"]:
 for r in fb.get("feedback_reference_replay",[]):
  record=obs[r["case_id"],r["family"]]
  assert r["record_sha256"]==csha(record) and r["raw_call_path"]==record["raw_call_path"]
  assert r["bank_sha256"]==record["bank_sha256"] and r["score"]==record["score"]
  refs.append({"case_id":r["case_id"],"family":r["family"],"actual_refreshed_parent_verified":True})
proposal=e.apply_differential_publication(parent,response["value"],e.FAMILIES,selected,guidance_schema=e.DIRECT_GUIDANCE)
changes=[];identical=collections.Counter()
for row in rows:
 a=e.actor_payload(row,parent,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 b=e.actor_payload(row,proposal,grounded=True,direct_numeric=True,asset_references=True)
 if csha(a[:2])==csha(b[:2]):identical[row["family"]]+=1
 else:changes.append({"case_id":row["case_id"],"family":row["family"]})
assert all(r["family"]=="EC" for r in changes) and identical["EV"]==48
opcounts=collections.Counter(o["operation"] for o in response["value"]["operations"])
delta=[]
for op in response["value"]["operations"]:
 for sid in op["target_ids"]:
  a=next(r for r in parent if r["id"]==sid)
  b=next(r for r in proposal if r["id"]==sid)
  delta.extend(difflib.unified_diff(json.dumps(a,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).splitlines(),json.dumps(b,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2).splitlines(),fromfile="actual_parent",tofile="actual_proposal",lineterm=""))
for p in ("wire_request.json","response.json","event_log.json"):paths.add(str((run/"teacher/b3_candidate2"/p).relative_to(root)))
out={"at":now(),"classification":"Actual B3teacher2 all64selected labels/parents/rawtraces andactualrefreshedfeedback refs; candidate2 not yet admission",
"teacher":response["model"],"request_sha256":response["request_sha256"],"parent_bank_sha256":csha(parent),"proposal_bank_sha256":csha(proposal),
"training_evidence_manifest":body["training_evidence_manifest"],"all64_actual_evidence_checks":checks,"all_actual_refreshed_references":refs,
"operations":response["value"]["operations"],"actual_operation_counts":dict(opcounts),"actual_proposal_record_count":len(proposal),"actual_text_diff":delta,
"all96_seen_actor_wires_identical_counts":dict(identical),"all96_seen_changed_actor_wires":changes,
"all48_EV_wires_unchanged_not_new_EV_learning":True,"legal_coordinates":e.legal_edit_coordinates(parent,proposal,rows),
"native_input_tokens":response["invocation"]["usage"]["input_tokens"],"native_output_tokens":response["invocation"]["usage"]["output_tokens"],
"reasoning_output_tokens_subset":response["invocation"]["usage"]["reasoning_output_tokens"],"elapsed_seconds":response["invocation"]["elapsed_seconds"],
"cache_hit":response["cache_hit"],"tool_events":response["invocation"]["tool_events_detected"],
"all_current_source_evidence_included_no_unseen229plus":True,"new_model_or_teacher_calls_by_audit":0,
"evidence_paths":sorted(paths)}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
